# FAMILY02 B — successor-visible case facts

Blank, cell, duplicate, and custody checks pass. Turbidity is 250 NTU. Reproducible composition is 84% mineral grains and 3% organic flocs, matching the measured mineral-dominant pattern. No gravimetric reference is provided.

response.rationale: Checks pass and composition matches the measured mineral-dominant pattern supported by OBS-01 through OBS-03. Applying 1.35 × 250 + 12 gives 349.5 mg/L. No independent reference establishes this case's actual residual.
response.scope: CE-F02-M0-R0 mineral-dominant calibration; validated turbidity range 0–500 NTU; uncertainty ±12 mg/L.
